title: Modelo × Seattle Kraken Mobile Game
subtitle: Product · Gaming
heroImageAlt: Modelo x Seattle Kraken retro mobile game

overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Retro-style, app-less mobile game driving sweepstakes participation. Full ownership of UX/UI, mobile design, and spritesheet development.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Drive sweepstakes participation without app friction while keeping brand energy high.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Designed a retro-style, app-less mobile game — owned UX/UI, mobile flows and spritesheet animation for lightweight, shareable play.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Engagement-driven sweepstakes touchpoint that converts through instant play, not installs.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for Modelo × Seattle Kraken — Retro-style, app-less mobile game driving sweepstakes participation. Full ownership of UX/UI, mobile design, and spritesheet development.
